rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Scans SKILL.md files, MCP configs, and system prompts for security threats before installation. Detects credential theft, data exfiltration, prompt injection, shell injection, zero-width character attacks, scope creep, and memory poisoning. Returns risk scores with severity ratings and shareable report links. Available via SSE endpoint, npm package, and REST API with no signup required.
